governance.rule: Preserve package-local verdicts, then apply the later intake and current-study claim ceiling. A PASS label never propagates automatically into NEXAH Core.

evidence_nodes.title: Polar-Janus Test 02 — navigation simulation
evidence_nodes.current_interpretation: Retained-phase simulation; not human-use evidence and not new astronomy.

evidence_nodes.title: Polar-Janus Test 03 — simulated generalisation
evidence_nodes.current_interpretation: Classical dynamic correction transfers; a site/angle invariant was rejected.

evidence_nodes.title: Polar-Janus Test 04 — field package
evidence_nodes.current_interpretation: No field data; readiness and dry-run status are not empirical evidence.

evidence_nodes.title: Polar-Janus Test 04A — archive coordinate benchmark
evidence_nodes.current_interpretation: Standards-based coordinate-translation evidence; not smartphone or new-field validation.

evidence_nodes.title: Polar-Janus Test 04C — five clocks, one observer
evidence_nodes.current_interpretation: Established astronomical beat periods reorganized as observer-relative orientation grammar.

evidence_nodes.title: Polar-Janus Test 05 — Q7 axis
evidence_nodes.current_interpretation: Exact modular orientation grammar, but 12 of 40 null progressions also match; no distinctive or physical pass.

evidence_nodes.title: Polar-Janus Test 06 — lunar aperture elevator
evidence_nodes.current_interpretation: Ephemeris trace representation; not a new astronomical mechanism.

evidence_nodes.title: Polar-Janus Test 07 — theta seam and closure
evidence_nodes.current_interpretation: Theta is confirmed as a seam-free translation coordinate; a constant ring is not a complete ephemeris model.

evidence_nodes.title: Polar-Janus Test 08 — historical LOD holdout
evidence_nodes.current_interpretation: Screened reproduction candidate only; chronology is not independently sealed and the candidate does not beat the later qualified geophysical baseline on known 2025 data.

evidence_nodes.title: Polar-Janus Test 08C — local specificity
evidence_nodes.current_interpretation: Post-hoc robustness context; not independent confirmation and not causality.

evidence_nodes.title: Polar-Janus Test 09 — phase quadrature and schlieren
evidence_nodes.current_interpretation: Quadrature is mathematically exact, but the +9.361% apparent gain ranks only at the 27.0th percentile of circular-shift nulls.

evidence_nodes.title: Q11 Tessarec packaging and Euler staircase
evidence_nodes.current_interpretation: Q7/Q11/Tesserac/SU(3) expansion remains unresolved and speculative; the simulation scales a constructed trace into historical gain ranges and is not an independent physical model.

evidence_nodes.title: POLAR-LOD-01 — prospective LOD validation
evidence_nodes.current_interpretation: Current authoritative route for the bounded prediction-method question; collection release is not granted and no prospective execution has occurred.

evidence_nodes.title: POLAR-LOD-BL-01 — strong baseline qualification
evidence_nodes.current_interpretation: Qualifies statistical and IERS zonal-tide comparators; on known 2025 data the old candidate does not beat the geophysical baseline.

evidence_nodes.title: POLAR-LOD-EAM-01 — operational baseline qualification
evidence_nodes.current_interpretation: Accepted historical B3 comparator method; no prospective execution authority or prospective result.

relations.explanation: The historical 10.969% result motivates the bounded prospective question but is not confirmation.
Local specificity informs controls but cannot serve as independent confirmation.
The prospective study must compare against the stronger statistical and geophysical baselines.
The sealed historical B3 method supports a future bounded operational comparison, not a current result.
An exact but non-distinctive Q7 grammar was expanded into Q11/Tessarec representations; empirical authority does not transfer.
The exact quadrature construction did not show specific predictive support and therefore constrains stronger phase-channel claims.
